tasks.label: HA-Testinstanz: Starten
tasks.command: docker compose -f devenv/compose.yaml up -d ha ; echo Home Assistant: http://127.0.0.1:8123

tasks.label: Tests ausfuehren
tasks.command: docker compose -f devenv/compose.yaml run --rm tools uv run pytest

tasks.label: Lint und Typpruefung
tasks.command: docker compose -f devenv/compose.yaml run --rm tools sh -c "uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run mypy"

tasks.label: Code formatieren
tasks.command: docker compose -f devenv/compose.yaml run --rm tools sh -c "uv run ruff check --fix . && uv run ruff format ."
